verdicts.flaw_description: Selection on treated runs: 'The figures cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service, and a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed.' A quarter of the post-upgrade runs are dropped from the reported figures, so filter-on runs are compared against a full earlier quarter; if bypassing happens under dirty/upset conditions the 8-14 percent drops are a selection artifact. Secondary: 'Throughput at each site fell by half against the earlier quarter' while the shield ('fired on a fixed duty cycle, the same hours whatever the throughput') only fixes running hours, not the material processed, so a halved load remains a live alternative explanation.

The outcome windows do not follow the intervention. 'pied flycatchers at Hollowmere reserve, boxed 3 June, measured by 27 March, fledged 14 more young than the same reserve in the previous spring' and 'barn owls at Brackenfen reserve, boxed 2 November, measured by 24 September' both have the measurement date preceding the installation date, and the credited breeding season (spring/autumn) is over before the boxes go up. Boxes installed after the fledging period cannot have caused the counted fledglings.

Outcome is scored only on the fully-treated subset: 'Rates cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat, and about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed.' A fifth of trays are excluded from the germination rate, and seed that takes a full coat can be systematically better seed, so the fully-coated subset is compared against an unfiltered previous spring sowing - an upward selection bias, not necessarily a coating effect.

Per-protocol selection: 'Pass rates cover the students who attended every block, and about a quarter of each cohort missed at least one block.' The reported pass rates come only from full attenders while the previous-term baseline is the whole cohort; attendance is self-selected and correlates with ability and motivation, so the 4-8 point gains could be entirely a healthy-adherer effect rather than an effect of the tutoring blocks.
